name: Umi Cache UI
notes:
Umi's interface kit. One stylesheet, no scripts, no external assets; works light+dark via prefers-color-scheme. TOKENS (:root) Colours: --bg, --bg-alt (recessed), --panel, --panel-2, --ink / --ink-2 / --ink-3 (text ramp), --line / --line-2 (hairlines), --accent, --accent-2, --accent-soft. Semantic: --good, --warn, --bad, --info each with a matching -soft tint. Add --shadow automatically; never hard-code hex. Shape/space/type: --r-xs…--r-pill, --s-1(4px)…--s-7(48px), --t-1(12px)…--t-7(36px), plus --font and --mono. Use var() everywhere so the dark override keeps working. LAYOUT .umi-page - centered column, max 760px, safe mobile padding. .stack / .row / .between / .divider for rhythm. .muted, .dim, .t-small for text levels. CHAT (transcript)
right-aligned accent bubble;
left-aligned panel bubble with an accent tick. Put a Name inside for the label. Optional .msg-row + .avatar for an avatar-aligned line. Keep text plain

tags; one emoji max, per Umi. COMPONENTS .card (+.flat), .card-title -> panel with hairline + soft shadow; .callout (+.info/.good/.warn/.bad) for asides and near-miss honesty labels. .badge (+.accent/.good/.warn/.bad/.info, optional ) for statuses like "cached match" / "near miss". .grid / .grid.two with .stat tiles (.label, .value, .value .unit, .delta.down) for dashboards; .meter + .progress (>span width %) for match confidence or cache coverage. .table-wrap > table with th/td (add class num for right-aligned numeric columns). ul.list / ol.list for bullets and steps; .timeline (li + .when) for sequence history. CHART CONTAINERS .chart wraps an inline / swatches. INTERACTIVITY (details/summary only) details.acc - accordion; details.tab - tab-like panels. Both styled with a +/- marker, .body inside. .quiz (+ .q, nested details per option, .answer), .flip for flash cards. .recipe (.head, .meta, .body, ul.ing two-column ingredients). pre.code / code / kbd for snippets; blockquote.quote with cite for the "as you once said" bit. RULES No
